from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class OperatingCostRecord(BaseModel):
    """Operating cost information extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company's full name as reported")
    securities_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/security code of the company, if provided")
    operating_cost: float | None = Field(description="The reported operating cost (营业成本) amount, in yuan")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The period the financial report covers, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the operating cost figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    operating_cost_records: list[OperatingCostRecord]
